text:
Marta (Sales): Zenith wants the POC scoped to regional residency: EU traffic stays in EU, APAC stays in APAC. They also insist KMS keys remain in-region and want an exported list of sub-processors per region. Need feasibility + quick price delta.

Niko (SE): Feasible for POC via tenant-level pinning. We support customer-managed keys (BYOK) in-region. For sub-processors, I'll grab the regional list. There are a few caveats: control-plane billing/audit events may hit our central control plane unless we configure a customer log sink.

Client_Zenith: Timeline is tight — kickoff Friday 2026-04-09. We need confirmation on whether backups or metrics will leave region. Also want an API example to set region pin.

Niko (SE): Backup/metrics: default backups may be multi-region for durability. For POC we can disable replication and keep backups in-region, but it requires a one-time ops change. Metrics export can be disabled or routed to customer-managed endpoint.

Samira (Compliance): We'll need a short attestation for the POC (30 days) that no PII-bearing logs are exported off-region. Also need the formal sub-processor list and SOC2 artifacts. I'll prepare a checklist.

Ops_Ella: Work items: 1) create tenant routing entry, 2) provision KMS (BYOK import or platform key in-region), 3) configure log sink to customer bucket, 4) disable replication for DB backups. Estimate 12-36 hours depending on BYOK import.

Marta (Sales): Can you provide a ballpark POC charge for these ops? Zenith asked for a budget-friendly quote.

Niko (SE): POC estimate: one-time setup $500 (routing + sink + config), BYOK import $120 one-time, key management surcharge $60/mo/region, and we waive analytics isolation fee for POC. Cross-region failover costs extra if requested.

Client_Zenith: Please share the API/SDK snippet we can include in our onboarding docs and confirm log sink pattern.

Niko (SE): API snippet (curl):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/tenants/zenith/pin \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \n  -d '{"region":"asia-northeast1","kms_key":"projects/zenith/locations/asia-northeast1/keys/key1"}'
```
Log sink: we'll create a delivery job to the customer bucket (s3://zenith-redwood-logs-eu) and set minimal retention.

Infra-bot: Job queued: tenant-pin-2401009876. Approvals required: infra-team + compliance.

Ops_Ella: Action items: post regional sub-processor list (EU, APAC) in this thread by EOD, confirm BYOK lead time, and confirm backup replication toggle.

Samira (Compliance): Once sub-processor list is posted I'll draft the POC attestation and return for signatures.

Marta (Sales): I'll send the POC quote and include the API snippet. Keeping the Friday kickoff target.

Client_Zenith: Thanks — we'll wait for the sub-processor list and the signed attestation.
